elements.description: A voice assistant's dot sphere that shows whether it's idle, listening, thinking or speaking.

properties.name: level
properties.description: Input or output loudness from 0 to 1 – unset, the orb fakes a natural level

properties.name: dots
properties.description: Number of dots – more is denser and costs a little more

properties.name: accent
properties.description: Colour the moving dots take on – any CSS colour. The resting dots use the text colour

properties.name: label
properties.description: The line under the orb; false hides it, an object replaces single texts

properties.name: interactive
properties.description: Dots give way to the pointer

properties.name: pressable
properties.description: Makes the orb a button (a native one inside) that fires tc-press

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-press
events.description: The orb was pressed (only when `pressable`); detail: undefined

props.name: onPress
props.description: Makes the orb a button, e.g. to start and stop listening

changelog: `tc-voice-mode` – a voice conversation: `tc-voice-orb` for the state, live captions that announce finished turns once, and Mute / Captions / Interrupt / End in a toolbar; Esc interrupts. The audio stays the app's.
